cues.en: Yes. It's happy fun ball, the toy sensation that's sweeping the nation. Only fourteen ninety five at participating stores. Get one today.
cues.zh: 没错，它是快乐趣味球，这款玩具风靡全国。参与活动的商店售价仅 14.95 美元。今天就买一个吧。

cues.en: Warning. Pregnant women, the elderly, and children 10 should avoid prolonged exposure to Happy Funball.
cues.zh: 警告：孕妇、老年人和 10 岁儿童应避免长时间接触快乐趣味球。

cues.en: Caution. Happy Funball may suddenly accelerate to dangerous speeds.
cues.zh: 注意：快乐趣味球可能会突然加速，达到危险速度。

cues.en: Happy Funball contains a liquid core which if exposed due to rupture should not be touched, inhaled or looked at.
cues.zh: 快乐趣味球内含液体。如果球体破裂导致液体泄漏，请勿触碰、吸入或注视液体。

cues.en: Do not use Happy Funball on concrete.
cues.zh: 切勿在水泥地面上使用 Happy Funball。

cues.en: Discontinue use of Happy Funball if any of the following occurs: itching vertigo dizziness tingling in extremities, loss of balance or coordination, slurred speech, temporary blindness, profuse sweating, or heart palpitations.
cues.zh: 若出现以下任何症状，请立即停用 Happy Funball：瘙痒、眩晕、头晕、四肢刺痛、失去平衡或协调能力、言语不清、暂时性失明、大汗淋漓或心悸。

cues.en: If happy fun ball begins to smoke, get away immediately, seek shelter, and cover head.
cues.zh: 如果 Happy Funball 开始冒烟，请立刻远离、寻找掩体并抱头防范。

cues.en: Funball may stick to certain types of skin.
cues.zh: Funball 可能会粘在某些类型的皮肤上。

cues.en: When not in use, Funball should be returned to its special container and kept under refrigeration.
cues.zh: 不使用时，应将 Funball 放回专用容器中并冷藏保存。

cues.en: Failure to do so relieves the makers of Happy Funball, Wacky Products Incorporated, and its parent company, Global Chemical Unlimited, of any and all liability.
cues.zh: 若不遵守上述规定，Happy Funball 的制造商 Wacky Products Incorporated 及其母公司 Global Chemical Unlimited 概不承担任何责任。

cues.en: Ingredients of Happy Funball include an unknown glowing substance which fell to earth presumably from outer space.
cues.zh: Happy Funball 的成分包括一种未知的发光物质，据推测是从外太空落到地球上的。

cues.en: Happy Funball has been shipped to our troops in Saudi Arabia and is also being dropped by our warplanes on Iraq.
cues.zh: Happy Funball 已运往我们在沙特阿拉伯的部队，我国战机也正在将其投放到伊拉克。

cues.en: Happy Funball comes with a lifetime guarantee. Happy
cues.zh: Happy Funball 提供终身保修。Happy
